info.title: Fenergo Nebula Audit Query
info.description:
The Audit Query API enables the retrieval of audit event data related to various activities within the system. It currently supports data for Journeys, Entities, Screening Tasks, and Financial Analysis events. Additionally, version 3 of the Audit Query API facilitates the extraction of access logs concerning both the access of entities and the access of sensitive data fields associated with those entities. This provides a comprehensive overview of the audit trails, ensuring transparency and traceability within the system.
Version 3(Preferable) Version 3 of the Audit Query API is organized into seven distinct sections:
  • AuditEvent: This section contains APIs responsible for retrieving raw audit event data, providing a comprehensive view of the various events occurring within the system.
  • EntityAccessLogs: This section consists of APIs that allow you to track which entities have been accessed and by whom. This enhances transparency and accountability within the system by providing a clear record of entity access events.
  • Entity: This section comprises APIs dedicated to retrieving entity-specific event data, offering insights into the events related to individual entities.
  • SensitiveDataAccessLog: This section includes APIs that enable the monitoring of users accessing sensitive data fields on entities. This helps to maintain data security and ensure that only authorized users are accessing sensitive information.
  • Authorization: This section contains APIs responsible for retrieving information about a User and Team changes
  • Narrative: This section contains APIs responsible for retrieving information about narrative changes
  • SelfServiceUserManagement: This section contains APIs responsible for retrieving information about self service user management changes

post.summary: Get Audit Events for a specific list of resource IDs in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method accepts a list of resource IDs and a pager object. The resource IDs indicate the records that are being sought, while the pager specifies the number of records to return in each page, the starting index of the first result, sorting field, and order (either "Ascending" or "Descending"). The resource IDs can refer to entities, journeys, or any other record type. The method then returns a list of audit events for each resource ID and a field indicating the total number of results.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

post.summary: Get Audit Events for a specific search term in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method takes in a list of resource IDs, a search term and a pager object. The resource IDs represent the identifiers of entities, journeys, or any other type of record, while the search term filters these records by either specifying a field name or a field value. The pager specifies the number of records to return in each page, the starting index of the first result, sorting field, and order (either "Ascending" or "Descending"). The method then returns a list of audit events for each resource ID and a field indicating the total number of results.
